title: living-architecture.yaml
description: Per-repo configuration at the repo root. Every key is optional; absent keys take their defaults.

tracker.description: Where issues live and, with openspec off, where the plan is persisted.

openspec.description: The flow keeps specs and changes under openspec/.

architecture.description: The repo has a living-architecture model (architecture/index.yaml).

codex.description: The flow runs Codex reviews; a missing Codex server stops it.

project_key.description: Overrides the Sonar project key otherwise inferred per PR.

issue_key_pattern.description: Full-match pattern for [target: <id>] tags; must use the portable regex subset (regex-subset.md).

test.description: The repo's full non-integration test command.

typecheck.description: la-typecheck's checker per language, run without a shell from the repo root; null turns the language off. Setting a language forces it on.

python.description: A basedpyright-compatible command: it must accept --writebaseline and keep its baseline at .basedpyright/baseline.json.

typescript.description: A tsc-compatible command; --pretty false is appended.

text_ratio_max.description: Cap on comment/docstring-only lines, as a fraction of each changed file group.

exempt.description: Repo-relative fnmatch globs exempt from the conventions gate.

rules.description: The conventions rule ids the gate enforces (conventions.yaml); [] turns the gate off.
